correctness.rationale: The actual binary operation (a,b)▷(c,d)=(a+b−d,b) changes only the first coordinate; for every base support B the nonempty fibers are invariant under each b−d and therefore under their prime-field additive span W. Conversely arbitrary nonempty W-coset unions in each fiber are closed. Uniqueness follows from support/fibers. Each B has a unique affine span, with p^(f−t)[f choose t]_p affine t-flats; Möbius inversion in the linear-subspace interval gives a_{t,j}, and independently chosen fiber unions contribute ((1+z^(p^t))^(p^(f−t))−1)^j. Exhaustive independent closure enumeration of actual 4-, 9-, and 16-point operation tables yields coefficients {1:4,2:2,4:1}, {1:9,2:9,3:3,6:3,9:1} and {1:16,2:24,3:16,4:28,6:24,8:6,12:4,16:1} respectively, exactly matching the all-field formula. Finite enumeration only corroborates the general bijection/inversion proof.
